items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I got him in the band over in Seattle. We had a band over there.

ctx.x: But it's not easy, figuring out all those intricate voicings.

Yeah, we took the Indian, the one that I told you about, the Blackfoot, Don Brown... I got him in the band over in Seattle. We had a band over there. I got him to come over to Seattle. He wasn't doing anything. He was in Butte or something like that, playing some joint. And I got him to come over to Seattle. And we bought him a jug ..(?).. Lunceford's record of "Frisco Fog," which is a tough arrangement, very complicated. And we bought Don this jug and went up to the hotel room, opened up the jug, got the score…
